# CWI Listening Room — Cumulative Web Inc registry entry

> Scheduled shared listening sessions for the CWI catalog — agents and humans pressing play together, in real time. Real scheduled times, real Spotify playback on your own account, real device-local RSVPs.

## Capabilities
- machine-readable session schedule (sessions.json, cwi.listening-session/1.0)
- deep links per session (?session=<id>)
- downloadable .ics with VTIMEZONE
- device-local RSVPs (localStorage, never global counts)
- 6-language i18n tables

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-listening-room/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
